note: Adjudication of recorded results. results.json files are never edited; a recorded FAIL caused by the QA script itself stays recorded and is classified here with the evidence that proves the cause.

QA-UI-039.evidence: gate2_controls/results.json (replay events=[]); scratch controls.sqlite3: REPLAY session STOPPED with 296 measurements, last timestamp 59000 ms (the detection time 68200 ms was never reached).
QA-UI-039.verified_part: Export (776 samples) -> browse dialog -> verify -> start Replay through the UI -> 296 samples ingested as a REPLAY session (all evidenced).
QA-UI-039.not_verified: Event detection during a UI-driven Replay. Indirect evidence only: the pytest suite (test_at014 export->Replay->event) passed in the baseline run; not a GUI test.
QA-UI-039.manual_steps: Source=Replay, Browse the exported trip.jsonl, Start, wait ~100 s, open the event list: expect MS_THERMAL with origin REPLAY.

QA-UI-041.not_verified: The script's own English-string criterion (invalid); behaviour is evidenced by the recorded values above.

qa_script_corrections_log.cause: read the identifier column instead of the value column of the sensor table
QTest.mouseDClick alone is not registered as a double-click; click then double-click is what a user does
chosen scenarios produced no event (a real coverage gap, now DEF-003); scenarios changed to ones that do and the gap recorded as QA-EVENT-015
assumed a missing parent folder raises; the repository creates parent folders by design
the generated upload stream was cut after 400 messages, dropping later HELLO messages; the product correctly rejected it
Windows reports a closed local port as TimeoutError (an OSError), not ConnectionRefusedError
memory probe returned 0.0 MB because ctypes types were missing; the PASS was meaningless and was rebuilt with a working probe
a 30-minute single session was mostly a parked vehicle (DEF-006); rebuilt as 12 consecutive real trips
NaN was injected with a text pattern that did not match the compact JSON, so the line was unchanged
the 'development tree on sys.path' check matched the substring 'doccar' in the scratch venv path; now compares against the real project root
spin-box test left severity at its minimum so no event existed; QCheckBox only reacts on its indicator; file dialog selectFile does not rename the default file; origin is stored in metadata_json
stub ignored age so the refusal was not demonstrated; reclassified PARTIAL and recorded as DEF-012
